references.text: Isaiah speaks of God's word standing firm forever, which is similar to what Jesus says about his words in Mark 13:31.
The book of Psalms contains a reference to heaven and earth passing away, parallel to Jesus' words in Mark 13:31.
In Hebrews, creation is described as perishable in contrast to Christ, who is unchangeable, echoing Jesus' words about his unchanging word in Mark 13:31.
Revelation speaks of a new heaven and a new earth, suggesting the perishability of the current heaven and earth, which Jesus mentions in Mark 13:31.
